coopcraft.protect.mark_blocked: Cannot add a gathering mark here: a player protection area or unavailable protection data blocks CoopCraft resident work. Existing marks can still be removed.

coopcraft.command.protect.help: /coop protect start "My house" (double-quote non-ASCII names and names with spaces), then sneak-right-click two corners with an empty main hand; review and /coop protect confirm. Other commands: cancel, list [page], show <UUID>, remove <UUID>. Reads use your current dimension, or the command dimension for the console. Only active players can change areas; creators can remove their own areas, and permission-level-2 operators can remove any area.
coopcraft.command.protect.scope: Only blocks CoopCraft residents from gathering and construction inside this X/Z rectangle, across the full build height. Does not protect against vanilla farmers, trampling, machines, neighboring or indirect block changes, or access to container contents. This is a resident-work restriction, not a land-ownership claim.
coopcraft.command.protect.started: Selecting '%s'. Sneak-right-click two blocks with an empty main hand. Limit: 128 × 128 blocks, 16 areas per creator per dimension, 128 areas per dimension. Nothing is saved until /coop protect confirm. Expires after 5 minutes of server ticks; disconnecting or changing dimension cancels it.
coopcraft.command.protect.first_corner: First corner: X=%s, Z=%s. Select the opposite corner with an empty-main-hand sneak-right-click.
coopcraft.command.protect.range: Dimension %s | X/Z (%s, %s) through (%s, %s), inclusive | %s × %s blocks | full build height Y=%s through %s.
coopcraft.command.protect.confirm_help: Review this range, then /coop protect confirm to save, or /coop protect cancel to discard. The two corners stay fixed after this preview. Selection clicks and brief trailing clicks are consumed so they cannot toggle resident resource/workstation marks.
coopcraft.command.protect.list: Protected areas in %s: %s total, page %s/%s. Use /coop protect list <page> and /coop protect show <UUID>.
